title: A Sampling Controller for Any Motion Model: Many Random Futures, Weighted by How Good They Are, and Why the Model Has to Be the Vehicle's

artifact.note: a sampling controller (model predictive path integral): roll out many noisy control sequences with a motion model, score each by distance from the path, closeness to the path's next stretch, and the cost grid, weight them by exp(-cost/lambda), and move the nominal sequence by the weighted noise; the motion model is a plug-in (a unicycle for a differential drive, a bicycle with a curvature limit for a car)
